title: LightningUsageByAppTypeMetrics - Data API
description: Represents number of users on Lightning Experience and Salesforce Mobile. This object is available in API version 43.0 and later.

AppExperience.description: User’s app (Lightning Experience or Salesforce Mobile).

MetricsDate.description: Date user accessed Lightning Experience or Salesforce Mobile.

UserId.description: UserId for user accessing Lightning Experience or Salesforce Mobile. This is a relationship field.

wsdl_segment:
```xml
<simpleType name="ID">
  <restriction base="xsd:string">
    <length value="18"/>
    <pattern value="[a-zA-Z0-9]{18}"/>
  </restriction>
</simpleType>
<complexType name="LightningUsageByAppTypeMetrics">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="AppExperience" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="MetricsDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:date"/>
        <element name="SystemModstamp" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="User" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="UserId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
```
